main_text.p: minum μικρολόγων pertinebant. Itaque in Nebulis Aristophanis lamentatur auarus ille Strepsiades,& puerum tantum non verberat, quòd ellychnia lucernæ adhibuisset crassa nimis. Aliusin Vefpis filium obiurgat, quòd stuppas non acu vel festuca, sed digito produxisset: ἡ ζεῦ, inquit, τὰς ἀλαΐς σπα-νίζοντ[?]. Iuuenalis,cuius dispenso & tempero filum.

Pag. 34. μάτε Συλλήμα(τα). ) Scribendum Συλλή-μα(τα). Sunt quæ alio nomine ψυχὰ dicuntur, hoc est, fruges ἐ-ψυσμέναι[?], siue fractæ saxo, vel molitæ. Latinis mole, vel liba. vide grammaticos. His solis antiquissimi homines deos sibi conciliabant, vt ait Ouidius in Fastis. quare cùm posterior ætas alia sumtuosiora facrificia vsurpare coepisset, is honos antiquitati habitus, vt non solùm adolendas victimarum partes farre confpergerent, (de quo ritu poetæ interpretes Ouidius vx.Metamorph.& Dionysius Halicar. libro v 1 r. aliiúque) sed etiam post omnia, extremo loco tandem Συλλήμα tanquam offerumentum Deo gratissimum offerrent. Notat hunc ritum Porphyrius Περὶ ἀποχῆς ἐμψύχων, lib. secundo, τὰ δ' ἀληλισμένα βίᾳ σιτοῦ τὸ πρόσθεν μακα-ρίτης ἀπόρξαντα τῆς ψευδείας προφῆς προσῶν εἰς τὴν τῆς θεοῦ, ὅτε ἔτι καὶ νῦν ἀρὸς τὰ τέλεα τοῦ Συν-λῶν, ὡς ψευδεῖον Συλλήμασι χρώμενα. Atque hoc pro-ptiè ὑπὸ ὑπόδ ὑπ posterior ætas dixit, vt docet idem au-ctor, quia post alia facrificia fiebat. Sed & Συλλή μα verbum est, quod significat Συλλήματα offerre. Por-phyrius eodem libro de pauperis Docimi oblatio-ne loquens, ἐκ τῆς ἀρτιφευμένης πόρας τῆς ἀλφίτων ὀλί-γας δράκας ἱθυλλάζ. Constat autem ex historia pau-periorum facrificia non alia ferè quàm ista fuisse.

page.notes: Greek passages are the least certain part of this page; they are marked with [?] where letters were doubtful. The word "ὑπὸ ὑπόδ ὑπ" and the Greek of the lower paragraph are partly illegible at this scan resolution and should be checked against the original. "Scribendum" line and the Greek after "ἡ ζεῦ" are doubtful. The running head "COMMENTARIVS." is printed in spaced capitals at the top, with the page number 231 at the top right.
